# Baatasari

> Baatasari (baatasari.com) is an Indian ticketing and events platform. People discover local events and book digital tickets; performers list a talent profile; organizers and venues use two companion sites. Payments are processed by Cashfree. Tickets carry a signed QR code that is scanned at the entrance.

## What you can do here
- [Browse and book events](https://baatasari.com/events): search by city, date and category. Each event page shows the organizer, venue, date, ticket tiers and price breakdown.
- [Find talent](https://baatasari.com/talent): a public directory of performers and artists (https://baatasari.com/talent/browse). Performers pay a one-time registration fee (currently ₹299) to be listed; their contact details are shown only to approved organizers.
- [Sell tickets as an organizer](https://baatasari.com/for-organizers): organizers sign up at https://organizer.baatasari.com.
- [List a venue](https://venue.baatasari.com): venue owners list at https://venue.baatasari.com for a one-time fee (currently ₹999).
- [Help and FAQs](https://baatasari.com/help)

## Key facts
- Baatasari is an intermediary: events are created, owned and run by their organizers.
- Platform fee: currently a flat ₹10 per paid ticket, inclusive of GST, shown at checkout before payment.
- At most 10 tickets per person per event.
- If an organizer or Baatasari cancels an event, the buyer is refunded in full. A confirmed ticket is otherwise not refundable unless the organizer agrees.
- Seats are held for about 15 minutes while you pay.
- Service area: India. Currency: INR.
